scope: Private, nonadvancing 2-D two-particle component using a protected JSphCpuSingle-derived Pair and the actual compiled Interaction_Forces_ct dispatch. This fixture does not copy the AV expression, override Run, exercise public initialization, solve a case, decode native output, run Darcy or MLS, establish general boundary or 3-D support, or grant physical acceptance.

source_observed_before_authoring.actual_AV_branch: InteractionForcesFluid around lines 2677-2704; PorosityFeedback with nonzero viscosity uses current receiver/neighbor mixture rho and neighbor volume*rho. Visco-zero takes the unchanged old branch; SPR derivative velocity does not replace dv_visc.

fixture_pattern.reused_structure_only: Protected Pair, two particles, one-cell StDivDataCpu, actual Interaction_Forces_ct, fresh output directory, CSV and completion. The old Near 20/2000 Pa floors are not reused.

physical_ledger_inputs: Reference Rho0=2, pore-water rho=1, n0=0.5, reference M0=1, Cs0=4, h=0.25, oblique separation=(0.0625,0,0.125), manual wall normal=(0,0,1), alpha=0.125. J pairs are (1,1), (0.75,1.25), (0.625,1.5), all strictly above 1-n0=0.5. Current rho, volume and mi are captured through the actual production GetPorosityFeedbackStateCpu helper; no AV formula is reproduced in this component.
state_reset_and_ownership: Every native call resets pressure, pore pressure, effective stress, acceleration, density/pore/stress derivative outputs and theta. PorosityObserver and PorosityFeedback are explicit; DynamicPorePressure, DynamicPoreWall and DynamicPoreConductivity stay false because this component bypasses public initialization and tests only fused interactions. SoilBoundaryDerivativeSPR stays false in all calls: derivative_scratch_present is a private manually supplied consumer buffer, not a public SPR producer switch. Np=2, Npb=0 for two fluid receivers or 1 for wall/fluid, NpbOk=0, begin cells={0,Npb,Npb,2}; the actual member DivData is set to the passed one-cell search. Borrowed BoundModec, BoundNormalc, TangenVelc, BoundDerivativeVelc, PoroJc, PoroThetac and DivData are nulled before base destruction; temporary call borrows are reset on return.
oracle: AV is the actual Visco-on minus Visco-zero acceleration, with zero initial pressure and stress. Each receiver gets separate actual compiled legacy-branch on/off calls using legacy density inputs equal to the current pair rho and the global legacy MassFluid=MassBound equal to that receiver neighbor current mi. Separate receiver calls are necessary because a single global legacy mass cannot represent unequal current mi for both nodes. Oracle mass and density conversions to float are recorded and covered by the predeclared float-roundoff budget. The reference is not a copied source expression.
trial_matrix: 31 input states: three physical J pairs, approach/rest/recession, two-fluid or fixed-wall/one-fluid; wall states each use derivative scratch absent and present. Two-fluid vz=(-motion/8,motion/8), wall stored vz=3/8, wall physical tangent velocity=0, wall fluid vz=motion/4, with motion=-1/0/1. Four extra manual tangent states use J=(0.75,1.25), vx_wall=vx_fluid=TangenVel.x=+/-1/8, zero normal velocity and scratch absent/present. On the oblique pair these require exact AV null rather than relying on a vertical dot product being blind to tangential errors. Each state has native Visco-on/off controls and independent passive legacy density mutation from (2,2) to (0.75,7). Manually supplied derivative auxiliary velocity=(0.5,0,0.75) is toggled without changing stored physical velocities or TangenVel. Nonzero derivative response is required while isolated AV stays unchanged. Expected authoring count is 248 native dispatch calls and 40 per-receiver CSV rows; root must verify actual completion rather than treating those expectations as observed results. This does not call the SPR/dynamic-wall producer or Init. Actual public SPR alias equivalence belongs to a separate project-main short.

predeclared_roundoff.force_comparison: For each Cartesian component, budget=64*epsilon_float*current_receiver_mi*(abs(actual_on)+abs(actual_off)+abs(reference_on)+abs(reference_off)). The reference may be the actual compiled legacy oracle, passive-Rhop mutation or derivative-scratch toggle. This covers the production float acceleration addition and on/off AV subtraction; no dimensional absolute floor is added.
predeclared_roundoff.fluid_pair_opposition: Each component uses actual current-mi-weighted isolated native forces F0 and F1. Budget=128*epsilon_float*(abs(F0)+abs(F1)); wall mirror quadrature is not treated as physical wall mass or subjected to a fictitious wall momentum check.
predeclared_roundoff.instantaneous_work: Fluid pair work=sum(F_i dot physical v_i); fixed-wall fluid relative work=F_fluid dot (v_fluid-v_tangent). Require strict negative work for approach and exact zero AV force for rest/recession. Compare actual and legacy-oracle work with budget=256*epsilon_float*sum(abs(actual work terms)+abs(reference work terms)); any allowed positive roundoff is also bounded by that budget.
predeclared_roundoff.zero_scale: A zero operand scale requires exactly zero error. Every Visco-zero acceleration and all rest/recession AV accelerations must be exactly zero. No unit floor, fitted tolerance or old Near floor is used.
predeclared_roundoff.scaled_error_gate: Each nonzero-budget error/budget must be <=1. Nonfinite diagnostics fail; completion prints nonfinite maxima as JSON null with passed=false.

J1_legacy_control: The (1,1) rows require the actual feedback force to match actual compiled legacy force with M=1 and rho=(2,2) within the same predeclared float budget. All calls keep the public SPR flag zero and include Visco-zero controls. Passive legacy Rhop mutation must not affect feedback AV; manual derivative-scratch mutation changes derivative outputs while the physical/tangent dv_visc sample remains fixed. No public SPR producer or initialization acceptance is claimed.
future_output: Run only the separately linked new component as upl_spr_av_pair_cpu_r1 --out <fresh tests/outputs directory>. It refuses any existing directory and writes pairs.csv plus completion.json. CSV records configured J/rho/velocities/differences, production current rho/V/mi, actual on/off and oracle accelerations, mi-weighted forces, derivative values, pair residual/work and every scaled error. completion.json explicitly labels private component, no time integration, no public initialization, no Darcy/MLS/general boundary/3-D/physical acceptance.
